title: Coolpad’s new $150 Android phone has a wider screen like the iPhone Duo, but doesn’t fold

claims.claim: Huawei Pura X View Çin'de Ağustos ayında piyasaya sürüldü.

evidence.quote: Similar to the Huawei Pura X View that launched in China in August, the new Coolpad Cool X Wide has a much wider screen than what’s typically seen in non-folding phones.
Similar to the Huawei Pura X View that launched in China in August

claims.claim: Coolpad Cool X Wide modeli ön siparişe açılmış olup Çin'de JD.com üzerinden 999 Çin Yuanı veya yaklaşık 150 dolardan satılmaktadır.

evidence.quote: The Coolpad Cool X Wide is now available for preorder through JD.com in China for 999 Chinese Yuan, or around $150

claims.claim: Coolpad Cool X Wide siyah, kırmızı veya beyaz renk seçenekleriyle sunulmaktadır.

evidence.quote: in black, red, or white color options.
The Coolpad Cool X Wide is now available for preorder through JD.com in China for 999 Chinese Yuan, or around $150, in black, red, or white color options.

claims.claim: Coolpad Cool X Wide modelinin sevkiyatlarının 8 Kasım'da başlaması beklenmektedir.

evidence.quote: Shipping is expected to start on November 8th.

claims.claim: Coolpad Cool X Wide, MediaTek Helio G99 işlemciye, 8GB RAM ve 128GB depolama alanına sahiptir.

evidence.quote: It’s powered by a MediaTek Helio G99 processor with 8GB of RAM and 128GB of storage.

claims.claim: Coolpad Cool X Wide modelinin 256GB depolama seçeneği yaklaşık 180 dolara, 12GB RAM seçeneği ise yaklaşık 209 dolara mal olmaktadır.

evidence.quote: You can bump that to 256GB of storage which pushes the price to around $180, or increase the RAM to 12GB for around $209.

claims.claim: Coolpad Cool X Wide, 16:10 en-boy oranına, 90Hz yenileme hızı ve 1.158x720 çözünürlüğe sahip 6.38 inç ekrana sahiptir.

evidence.quote: The Cool X Wide’s 6.38-inch display has a 16:10 aspect ratio with refresh rates up to 90Hz and a 1,158x720 resolution.

claims.claim: Coolpad Cool X Wide, arkada 50 megapiksel ana kamera ve 4.600mAh batarya ile kutudan Android 16 işletim sistemiyle çıkmaktadır.

evidence.quote: There’s also a 50-megapixel main camera on the back and a 4,600mAh battery. It comes with Android 16 out of the box
